now: Four years after the world forgot him, Peter lives alone in a small apartment and gives his whole life to being Spider-Man. The strain sets off new changes in his body, including organic webbing, and he builds an inhibitor chip to hold them back, turning to Bruce Banner, who no longer knows him. Jean Grey, a telepath whose sister died in Damage Control's experiments, takes control of the Hulk, and Peter gets through to Bruce. Frank Castle becomes an unlikely ally and hides MJ, who still doesn't know Peter. At Damage Control's Roosevelt Island facility, Peter takes off his inhibitor to fight his way past the Hand and stops Jean from killing Damage Control's director, Bill Metzger. Then he lets her into his mind, where a memory of Aunt May reaches her, and he takes the Punisher's bullet meant for her. Jean keeps him alive, and recovering, Peter sees Ned again, who says his name. After the credits, Ned's tracker shows Spider-Man somewhere in space, and no one knows why.

entry.x: Scientist Bruce Banner survives a gamma accident in his lab at Berkeley and becomes the Hulk, while his father David, who experimented on his own son years ago, turns himself into something worse. General Ross, the father of Bruce's colleague Betty, hunts the Hulk across the desert and into San Francisco, where Betty talks him down. Bruce fights his father one last time and disappears to a jungle clinic in South America. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-400083 is marked terminated.
